Food

What is on the buffet

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Salads and meze

Salads, bread, yoghurt, tahini and olives to fill your plate. 5 Google reviews mention the salads.

Kleftiko and souvla

Lamb kleftiko with potatoes is brought to the table. 4 reviews mention the kleftiko, and guests list souvla, keftedes and koupepia.

Sunday buffet

On Sundays from 10:00 to 18:00, Wednesday to Saturday in the evening. Guests write about souvla, pasta, snails and more on Sundays.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Traditional

4 Google reviews mention the Cypriot food. One guest writes it is mainly frequented by locals.

Eat as much as you like

One guest writes they ate as much as they wanted from the buffet, another praises the low prices and fast, friendly service.

In the mountains

On the road from Nicosia to Palaichori. One guest mentions the views of the pine-covered mountains.

On the road to Palaichori

In Apliki, on the Nicosia to Palaichori road. Open Wednesday to Saturday from 18:00 to 22:00 and Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00. Closed on Monday and Tuesday.

What guests say

Three of 66 Google reviews, 51 of them with five stars.

“If you are looking for traditional Greek Cypriots food, this is a great place. Freshly cooked, tasty, well presented and served at a good temperature. The service is friendly and efficient. On Sundays there is a buffet with souvla (barbecued meat, kleftiko, pasta, salads and more).Good cold drinks. Nice views of the surrounding pine covered mountains.”

Google review
“Paliomylos restaurant is an absolute hidden gem. If you are ever driving through this way in Cyprus you must stop in around 9pm for a traditional buffet meal. Once you are seated and the waiter takes your drinks order, you are free to fill your plate with the dishes on offer at the buffet. This will include salads, bread, yogurt, tahini, olives, etc. When the whole table sits back down the waiter will then bring the lamb kleftiko and potatoes which is so tender and soft it falls off the bone.”

Google review
“Sunday buffet style traditional Cyprus dishes in good variety and good taste. Low prices and fast friendly service. Pork lamb and chicken, koupepia keftedes and macaroni/ravioli, lamb liver and mushrooms, snails and kleftiko and few salads/cold sides.”
